source.title: Faculty of Engineering & Design — departments and programs (MEU website + official study plans 2025/2026)
source.notes: Department list from the MEU website page 'Faculty of Engineering and Design Departments' (screenshot provided by the student on 2026-11-06). Degree types and credit hours come from the five official 2025/2026 study plans in data/knowledge/documents/. Biomedical Engineering (not on that department list) was added from its official 2025/2026 study plan and the Student Handbook 2025/2026 program table (page 18).

chunks.text:
Faculty of Engineering & Design (كلية الهندسة والتصميم) at Middle East University — departments and bachelor programs (2025/2026) — six programs:
1. Intelligent Systems Engineering (هندسة الأنظمة الذكية) — B.Sc., 162 credit hours.
2. Renewable Energy Engineering (هندسة الطاقة المتجددة) — B.Sc., 162 credit hours.
3. Architecture / Architectural Engineering (هندسة العمارة) — B.Sc., 165 credit hours (a five-year program according to the department).
4. Interior Design (التصميم الداخلي) — Bachelor (BA), 141 credit hours.
5. Graphic Design (التصميم الجرافيكي) — Bachelor (BA), 135 credit hours.
6. Biomedical Engineering (الهندسة الطبية الحيوية) — B.Sc., 162 credit hours (official 2025/2026 study plan; also listed in the Student Handbook 2025/2026).
Dean of the Faculty (as signed on the 2025/2026 study plans): Prof. Ayman Abdel Salam Awad.
